overviewParagraphs: Located just outside Phnom Penh, Chhun On Golf Resort is an impressive 36-hole golfing sanctuary that features two highly contrasting and world-class championship courses: the Lakes Course and the Palm Course.

The Lakes Course, designed by renowned architect Brian Curley, is a visual masterpiece characterized by expansive water hazards that come into play on almost every hole. The strategic placement of water demands precision and shot-making skills, while the beautifully contoured fairways and platinum paspalum greens offer a truly rewarding experience.

The Palm Course offers a distinctly different, classic parkland feel. Framed by hundreds of indigenous palm trees, the layout challenges golfers with its mature, natural setting, requiring careful positioning off the tee and strategic navigation to the well-protected greens.
Both courses are complemented by first-class resort amenities, making Chhun On a must-play destination on any luxury Cambodian golf tour.

curatorBriefHtml: Chhun On Golf Resort (opened 2023 on the outskirts of Phnom Penh) is Cambodia’s boldest new 36-hole championship arrival — headlined by the Lakes Course designed by renowned architect Brian Curley (Curley-Wagner Design, famed for Mission Hills China and Siam Country Club’s newer loops). Playing 6,200 yards from the Blue Tees (stretching past 7,300 yards from the tips, Par 72), the Platinum Paspalum layout features sweeping sculpted dunes, sprawling waste bunkers, and dramatic island-edge water holes.

Together with its companion 18-hole Palm Course, Chhun On instantly elevates Phnom Penh from a quick 2-day stop into a legitimate 4- to 5-round luxury golf hub — giving returning travelers a brand-new world-class modern design alongside Vattanac and Garden City.
AGS pairs Chhun On Golf Resort smoothly with Vattanac East, Vattanac West, and Garden City from central Phnom Penh 5-star hotels.

scorecard.verdict: Brian Curley's newest design near Phnom Penh. Dramatic water features, expansive waste bunkers, and a signature island green deliver high-stakes excitement on every shot.

faqs.q: What makes Chhun On Golf Resort's Lakes Course stand out in Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Opened in 2023 and crafted by Brian Curley, the Lakes Course brings dramatic modern dune shaping, Platinum Paspalum conditioning, and sweeping lakeside risk-reward holes — making it Phnom Penh’s premier new rival to Vattanac.

faqs.q: How many holes does Chhun On Golf Resort have?
faqs.a: 36 championship holes across two 18-hole layouts: Brian Curley’s flagship Lakes Course and the companion Palm Course.

faqs.q: How far is Chhun On Golf Resort from central Phnom Penh?
faqs.a: Plan for roughly 45 to 55 minutes north of central Phnom Penh by luxury private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: When is the prime weather window for Chhun On Golf Resort?
faqs.a: November through March offers dry, sunny Cambodian mornings and firm Platinum Paspalum fairways.
